dct_description_sm:
Provides the total registered voters and actual votes cast for the Mayor by ward. The number of advance votes cast by ward is also provided.

Accuracy: There are no known errors within the data set.

Update Frequency: n/a

Attributes: Overall Vote Tab: Ward: ward number and name. Electors: number of registered voters for the ward. Votes: number of votes cast by ward. %: percentage of electors casting votes. Advance Vote Tab: Ward: ward number and name. Oct-02: votes cast on October 2nd advance polling date by ward. Oct-14: votes cast on October 14th advance polling date by ward.

Contact: Elections & MFIPPA Branch, City Clerk & Solicitor Dept.
